title: Prepositions after adjectives
summary: Устойчивые сочетания «прилагательное + предлог» (**capable of, notorious for, similar to**), прилагательные с несколькими предлогами и конструкция **kind of you to...**.
ru:
## Предлог привязан к прилагательному
Предлог после прилагательного почти никогда не выводится по логике — его надо знать как часть сочетания. Зато схема проста: после предлога стоит существительное, местоимение, **-ing** или вопросительное слово, но не инфинитив.
> She is **capable of** managing the whole department. — Она способна управлять всем отделом.
> I'm not **aware of** any problems. — Мне не известно ни о каких проблемах.
> We were **doubtful about** whether to sign. — Мы сомневались, подписывать ли.
- ~~He is capable to do it.~~ → He is capable **of doing** it.
- ~~I'm afraid of to fail.~~ → I'm afraid **of failing**.

## Один предлог — «человек», другой — «предмет»
Многие прилагательные меняют предлог в зависимости от того, о ком или о чём речь.
> She is **angry with** her colleague **about / over** the delay. — Она сердита на коллегу из-за задержки.
> I'm **sorry for** the noise. / I'm **sorry about** the mix-up. — Извините за шум. / Мне жаль, что так вышло.
> **Good at** maths, **good for** your health, **good to** your friends. — Хорош в математике / полезен для здоровья / добр к друзьям.
> **Afraid of** spiders, **afraid for** her safety (= опасаюсь за неё). — Боюсь пауков / боюсь за её безопасность.

## Разные предлоги у близких по смыслу слов
> **different from / to** (BrE), **different from / than** (AmE) — отличный от
> **similar to**, **identical to**, **equal to**, **superior / inferior to** — все с **to**
> **keen on** (BrE разг.) / **keen to do** — увлечён / стремится
> **typical of**, **characteristic of**, **representative of** — с **of**
> **responsible for**, **notorious for**, **famous for**, **known for** — с **for**
> **tired of** (надоело) vs **tired from** (устал от усилий)

## It is kind of you to...
Оценка поступка человека строится с **of**; оценка ситуации или «как это для кого-то» — с **for**.
> It was **kind of you** to wait. — Любезно с вашей стороны, что подождали.
> It's **silly of him** to refuse. — Глупо с его стороны отказываться.
> It's **essential for the team** to meet the deadline. — Команде важно уложиться в срок.
> It's **easy for me** to say. — Мне легко говорить.

## -ing после предлога, to как предлог
У некоторых прилагательных **to** — предлог, поэтому дальше идёт -ing: **accustomed to, used to, committed to, opposed to, dedicated to, resigned to**.
> She is **committed to improving** the service. — Она намерена улучшать сервис.
> I'm not **accustomed to being** interrupted. — Я не привык, чтобы меня перебивали.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She is married with a doctor.~~ → She is married **to** a doctor.
- ~~He is very good in cooking.~~ → He is very good **at** cooking.
- ~~I'm interested for the job.~~ → I'm interested **in** the job.
- ~~We are looking forward to see you.~~ → We are looking forward **to seeing** you. (to — предлог)
en:
## The preposition belongs to the adjective
The preposition after an adjective is rarely logical, so learn the pair together. After the preposition we use a noun, pronoun, **-ing** form or question word, not an infinitive.
> She is **capable of** managing the whole department.
> I'm not **aware of** any problems.
> We were **doubtful about** whether to sign.
- ~~He is capable to do it.~~ → He is capable **of doing** it.
- ~~I'm afraid of to fail.~~ → I'm afraid **of failing**.

## One adjective, different prepositions
Many adjectives take a different preposition depending on what follows.
> She is **angry with** her colleague **about / over** the delay. (with a person, about a thing)
> I'm **sorry for** the noise. / I'm **sorry about** the mix-up.
> **Good at** maths, **good for** your health, **good to** your friends.
> **Afraid of** spiders, **afraid for** her safety (= worried about her).

## Similar meaning, different prepositions
> **different from / to** (BrE), **different from / than** (AmE)
> **similar to**, **identical to**, **equal to**, **superior / inferior to** — all with **to**
> **keen on** (BrE informal) / **keen to do**
> **typical of**, **characteristic of** — with **of**
> **responsible for**, **notorious for**, **famous for** — with **for**
> **tired of** (fed up) vs **tired from** (exhausted by effort)

## It is kind of you to...
To judge a person's behaviour we use **of**; to describe a situation as it affects someone we use **for**.
> It was **kind of you** to wait.
> It's **silly of him** to refuse.
> It's **essential for the team** to meet the deadline.
> It's **easy for me** to say.

## -ing after a preposition, and to as a preposition
With some adjectives **to** is a preposition, so an -ing form follows: **accustomed to, used to, committed to, opposed to, dedicated to, resigned to**.
> She is **committed to improving** the service.
> I'm not **accustomed to being** interrupted.

## Common mistakes
- ~~She is married with a doctor.~~ → She is married **to** a doctor.
- ~~He is very good in cooking.~~ → He is very good **at** cooking.
- ~~I'm interested for the job.~~ → I'm interested **in** the job.
- ~~We are looking forward to see you.~~ → We are looking forward **to seeing** you.
structure:
## Схемы
> прилагательное + **предлог** + существительное / местоимение: **fond of** jazz
> прилагательное + **предлог** + **-ing**: **capable of** winning
> **It is** + прилагательное + **of** + человек + **to-инфинитив**: It was **generous of her** to donate.
> **It is** + прилагательное + **for** + кто-то + **to-инфинитив**: It is **vital for us** to agree.

## Таблица: основные сочетания
| Предлог | Прилагательные | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| **of** | aware, capable, fond, typical, afraid, ashamed, jealous, suspicious | She is **jealous of** his success. |
| **for** | responsible, notorious, famous, eligible, grateful | The town is **notorious for** its traffic. |
| **to** | similar, superior, married, allergic, accustomed, opposed | He is **allergic to** nuts. |
| **at** | good, bad, brilliant, hopeless, surprised | I'm **hopeless at** parking. |
| **in** | interested, involved, rich, disappointed (in sb) | They are **involved in** the project. |
| **with** | satisfied, pleased, bored, familiar, angry (with sb) | We are **familiar with** this software. |
| **about** | concerned, anxious, enthusiastic, nervous, certain | He is **enthusiastic about** the plan. |
| **on** | keen, dependent, intent | She is **dependent on** her parents. |

items.text: The region is notorious {{for}} its unpredictable weather.
I'm not familiar {{with}} this software.
He is allergic {{to}} penicillin.
Are you capable {{of}} working under such pressure?
She is hopeless {{at}} remembering names.
The new design is quite similar {{to}} the old one.
My sister is married {{to}} a diplomat.
Nobody was aware {{of}} the risk.

exercises.title: Предлог + -ing
exercises.instruction: Вставьте предлог и глагол в форме -ing: сначала предлог, потом глагол. Предложение читается целиком.

items.text: She is committed {{to}} {{improving}} working conditions.
He is not accustomed {{to}} {{being}} told what to do.
We are opposed {{to}} {{raising}} the fees.
They are keen {{on}} {{expanding}} abroad.
I'm tired {{of}} {{waiting}} for his reply.
She is capable {{of}} {{learning}} a language in months.
He was ashamed {{of}} {{lying|having lied}} to his clients.

exercises.title: kind of you / easy for me

items.text: It was very generous {{of}} you to lend us the money.
It is essential {{for}} the staff to attend the briefing.
It was careless {{of}} him to leave the door unlocked.
It's difficult {{for}} older people to learn new software.
It was rude {{of}} them not to say thank you.
It's not safe {{for}} children to swim here.
It was thoughtful {{of}} her to send flowers.

items.q: Fresh fruit is good ___ your health.
He has always been very good ___ his younger brother.
I'm worried ___ my sister; she hasn't called in days.
The two proposals are identical ___ each other.

items.q: This laptop is superior ___ the previous model.
The company is responsible ___ the damage.

exercises.title: Перефразируйте
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя прилагательное из скобок и нужный предлог.

items.prompt: Tom can swim long distances. (capable) → Tom is ...

items.prompt: The city is well known for its crime rate. (notorious) → The city is ...
answers: The city is notorious for its crime rate.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя сочетания «прилагательное + предлог».

items.prompt: What are you good at, and what are you hopeless at?
items.sample: I'm good at organising things, but I'm hopeless at drawing.

items.prompt: What are you keen on or fond of?
items.sample: I'm keen on hiking and fond of old black-and-white films.

items.prompt: Name something you are tired of.
items.sample: I'm tired of waiting for buses in the rain.

items.prompt: Write about a place that is famous or notorious for something.
items.sample: My hometown is famous for its apple orchards, but it is also notorious for its terrible traffic.
